description: SvRating in Svelte 5 as a review widget: an interactive star input with a live text label, plus a read-only aggregate that shows half stars and a distribution breakdown per star count. The value and onChange keep it controlled, size sets the star scale, allowHalf enables half-star steps and readOnly turns it into a display.

faq.question: How do I show an average with half stars?
faq.answer: Pass a fractional value such as 4.3 with allowHalf and readOnly; the stars render partial fills at half-star precision without accepting input.

faq.question: How is the live label produced?
faq.answer: A small array maps each star count to a word; a $derived picks the entry for the current value and prints it next to the stars.

faq.question: Is the rating keyboard accessible?
faq.answer: Yes. Each star is a button with its own aria-label, the group carries a label, arrow keys and Tab move between stars and hover previews the value before a click commits it.
